title: No-AI Language Path
user: A privacy- or quality-conscious language learner who wants a structured interactive routine without generative AI or opaque personalization.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The asker specifically seeks an interactive language app/site that does not use LLMs or generative AI because familiar products now do.
A user reports that changing a deck preset silently overwrites desired retention, illustrating the need for visible, trustworthy study settings rather than hidden personalization.

recurrence: A direct 2026 request and a separate 2025 configuration failure both point to demand for learner agency and inspectable rules.
current_workaround: Use scattered Anki decks, textbooks, and podcasts, or accept an app whose AI behavior and personalization are not controllable.
incumbents_and_gap: Duolingo, Babbel, Busuu, and many newer apps add AI features; Anki is flexible but starts as a blank system. The gap is a transparent routine builder that never sends text to a model.
smallest_useful_product: An offline routine composer combining user-selected listening, reading, speaking, and recall blocks with timer/checklists and plain rule-based progression. Non-goals: chat tutoring, auto-generated exercises, or content licensing.
success_measure: In a four-week beta, 60% of users complete a self-authored routine at least three days/week and can correctly explain every progression rule shown in their plan.
monetization: one-time — its promise is durable local control rather than a metered AI service.
constraints: Prominently commit to no model calls and no telemetry by default; user-provided links/files must remain private; avoid claims that a fixed routine produces fluency.
why_distinct: The product’s value is inspectable non-generative structure, not an LLM tutor with a privacy toggle.
